Please refer to the Resolution dated 224 May, 2012 issued by Ministry
of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) regarding declaration of rate of
interest of General Provident Fund (GPF) and other similar funds.

2. In this connection, it is announced for general information that during
the year 2012-2013, accumulations at the credit of subscribers to the Staff
Provident Fund shall carry interest at the rate of 8.8% (Eight point eighy
percent) per annum w.e.f. 01.04.2012.
